source_text_en: Supportive and Palliative Care Indicators Tool (SPICT-4ALL-……)
candidate_fi: Tukea antavan ja palliatiivisen hoidon tunnusmerkkityökalu (SPICT-4ALL-……)
back_translation_en: Supportive and palliative care indicator tool (SPICT-4ALL-……)

source_text_en: The SPICT helps us look for people who have life shortening health conditions and are less well. These people need more help and care now, and a plan for care in the future.
candidate_fi: SPICT auttaa meitä etsimään ihmisiä, joilla on elinikää lyhentäviä terveydentiloja ja joiden terveydentila on heikentynyt. Nämä ihmiset tarvitsevat nyt enemmän apua ja hoitoa sekä suunnitelman tulevasta hoidosta.
back_translation_en: SPICT helps us look for people who have life-shortening health conditions and whose health has deteriorated. These people now need more help and care, as well as a plan for future care.

source_text_en: Does this person have signs of poor health or health problems that are getting worse?
candidate_fi: Onko tällä henkilöllä merkkejä huonosta terveydentilasta tai terveysongelmia, jotka pahenevat?
back_translation_en: Does this person have signs of poor health or health problems that are getting worse?

source_text_en: Urgent or emergency hospital admission(s) or visits.
candidate_fi: Kiireellinen tai päivystyksellinen sairaalaan otto(t) tai käynnit.
back_translation_en: Urgent or emergency hospital admission(s) or visits.

source_text_en:
Less able to manage usual activities; not as well as they used to be.
(Person often stays in bed or in a chair for more than half the day.)
candidate_fi:
Toimintakyky on heikentynyt tavanomaisissa toimissa; vointi ei ole yhtä hyvä kuin ennen.
(Henkilö viettää usein yli puolet päivästä vuoteessa tai tuolissa.)
back_translation_en:
Functioning has declined in usual activities; the person's condition is not as good as before.
(The person often spends more than half of the day in bed or in a chair.)

source_text_en: Needs more help and care from others due to increasing physical and/or mental health problems.
candidate_fi: Tarvitsee muilta enemmän apua ja hoitoa lisääntyvien fyysisen terveyden ja/tai mielenterveyden ongelmien vuoksi.
back_translation_en: Needs more help and care from others because of increasing physical health and/or mental health problems.

source_text_en: Person’s carer needs more help and support.
candidate_fi: Henkilöstä huolehtiva ihminen tarvitsee enemmän apua ja tukea.
back_translation_en: The person who cares for them needs more help and support.

source_text_en: Has clearly lost weight over the last few months; or stays too thin.
candidate_fi: On selvästi laihtunut muutaman viime kuukauden aikana; tai pysyy liian laihana.
back_translation_en: Has clearly lost weight during the last few months; or remains too thin.

source_text_en: Has troublesome symptoms most of the time despite good treatment of their health problems.
candidate_fi: Hänellä on hankalia oireita suurimman osan ajasta, vaikka hänen terveysongelmiaan hoidetaan hyvin.
back_translation_en: Has troublesome symptoms most of the time, even though their health problems are treated well.

source_text_en: The person (or family) asks for palliative care; chooses to reduce, stop or not have treatment; or wishes to focus on quality of life.
candidate_fi: Henkilö (tai perhe) pyytää palliatiivista hoitoa; valitsee hoidon vähentämisen, lopettamisen tai ottamatta jättämisen; tai toivoo keskittymistä elämänlaatuun.
back_translation_en: The person (or family) asks for palliative care; chooses to reduce, stop, or not take treatment; or wishes to focus on quality of life.

source_text_en: Does this person have any of these health problems?
candidate_fi: Onko tällä henkilöllä jokin näistä terveysongelmista?
back_translation_en: Does this person have any of these health problems?

source_text_en: Cancer
candidate_fi: Syöpä
back_translation_en: Cancer

source_text_en: Heart or circulation problems
candidate_fi: Sydämen tai verenkierron ongelmat
back_translation_en: Heart or circulation problems

source_text_en: Kidney problems
candidate_fi: Munuaisongelmat
back_translation_en: Kidney problems

source_text_en: Less able to manage usual activities and health is getting poorer.
candidate_fi: Toimintakyky on heikentynyt tavanomaisissa toimissa, ja terveys heikkenee.
back_translation_en: Functioning has declined in usual activities, and health is deteriorating.

source_text_en: Heart failure or heart blood vessel disease. Short of breath or has chest pain when resting, moving or walking a few steps.
candidate_fi: Sydämen vajaatoiminta tai sydämen verisuonisairaus. Hengenahdistusta tai rintakipua levätessä, liikkuessa tai kävellessä muutaman askeleen.
back_translation_en: Heart failure or disease of the heart's blood vessels. Shortness of breath or chest pain when resting, moving, or walking a few steps.

source_text_en: Kidneys are not working well; general health is getting poorer.
candidate_fi: Munuaiset eivät toimi hyvin; yleinen terveys heikkenee.
back_translation_en: The kidneys are not working well; general health is deteriorating.

source_text_en: Not well enough for cancer treatment or treatment is to help with symptoms.
candidate_fi: Ei ole riittävän hyväkuntoinen syöpähoitoon, tai hoito on oireiden helpottamiseksi.
back_translation_en: Is not well enough for cancer treatment, or the treatment is for relieving symptoms.

source_text_en: Leg problems due to poor blood circulation; surgery is not possible.
candidate_fi: Jalkaongelmia huonon verenkierron vuoksi; leikkaus ei ole mahdollinen.
back_translation_en: Leg problems because of poor circulation; surgery is not possible.

source_text_en: Stopping kidney dialysis or choosing palliative care instead of starting dialysis.
candidate_fi: Munuaisdialyysin lopettaminen tai palliatiivisen hoidon valitseminen dialyysin aloittamisen sijaan.
back_translation_en: Stopping kidney dialysis or choosing palliative care instead of starting dialysis.

source_text_en: Stopping or not starting dialysis
candidate_fi: Dialyysin lopettaminen tai aloittamatta jättäminen
back_translation_en: Stopping dialysis or not starting it

source_text_en: Dementia or frailty
candidate_fi: Dementia tai hauraus
back_translation_en: Dementia or frailty

source_text_en: Respiratory problems
candidate_fi: Hengitysongelmat
back_translation_en: Breathing problems

source_text_en: Liver problems
candidate_fi: Maksaongelmat
back_translation_en: Liver problems

source_text_en: Unable to dress, walk or eat without help.
candidate_fi: Ei pysty pukeutumaan, kävelemään tai syömään ilman apua.
back_translation_en: Cannot dress, walk, or eat without help.

source_text_en: More unwell with long term lung problems. Short of breath when resting, moving or walking a few steps even when the chest is at its best.
candidate_fi: Vointi on huonompi pitkäaikaisten keuhko-ongelmien yhteydessä. Hengenahdistusta levätessä, liikkuessa tai kävellessä muutaman askeleen silloinkin, kun rintakehä on parhaimmillaan.
back_translation_en: The person's condition is worse with long-term lung problems. Shortness of breath when resting, moving, or walking a few steps even when the chest is at its best.
backtranslator_uncertainty: The wording "when the chest is at its best" is unusual and may be ambiguous; it is translated literally from the Finnish.

source_text_en: Worsening liver problems in the past year with complications like:
candidate_fi: Kuluneen vuoden aikana pahentuneita maksaongelmia, joihin liittyy lisäongelmia, kuten:
back_translation_en: Liver problems that have worsened during the past year, with additional problems such as:

source_text_en: fluid building up in the belly
candidate_fi: nesteen kertymistä vatsaan
back_translation_en: fluid accumulating in the abdomen

source_text_en: being confused at times
candidate_fi: ajoittaista sekavuutta
back_translation_en: occasional confusion

source_text_en: kidneys not working well
candidate_fi: munuaiset eivät toimi hyvin
back_translation_en: the kidneys are not working well

source_text_en: infections
candidate_fi: infektioita
back_translation_en: infections

source_text_en: bleeding from the gullet
candidate_fi: verenvuotoa ruokatorvesta
back_translation_en: bleeding from the oesophagus

source_text_en: Eating and drinking less; difficulty with swallowing.
candidate_fi: Syö ja juo vähemmän; nielemisvaikeuksia.
back_translation_en: Eats and drinks less; difficulty swallowing.

source_text_en: Needs to use oxygen for much of the day and night.
candidate_fi: Tarvitsee käyttää happea suuren osan päivästä ja yöstä.
back_translation_en: Needs to use oxygen for a large part of the day and night.

source_text_en: Has poor control of bladder and bowels.
candidate_fi: Virtsarakon ja suolen hallinta on heikkoa.
back_translation_en: Bladder and bowel control is poor.

source_text_en: Has needed treatment with a breathing machine in hospital.
candidate_fi: On tarvinnut sairaalassa hoitoa hengityskoneella.
back_translation_en: Has needed treatment in hospital with a ventilator.

source_text_en: Not able to communicate by speaking; not responding much to other people.
candidate_fi: Ei pysty viestimään puhumalla; ei vastaa juurikaan muihin ihmisiin.
back_translation_en: Cannot communicate by speaking; responds very little to other people.

source_text_en: Frequent falls; fractured femur.
candidate_fi: Toistuvia kaatumisia; reisiluun murtuma.
back_translation_en: Repeated falls; fracture of the femur.

source_text_en: Frequent infections; pneumonia
candidate_fi: Toistuvia infektioita; keuhkokuume
back_translation_en: Repeated infections; pneumonia

source_text_en: Nervous system problems
candidate_fi: Hermoston ongelmat
back_translation_en: Nervous system problems

source_text_en: Other conditions
candidate_fi: Muut terveydentilat
back_translation_en: Other health conditions

source_text_en: Physical and mental health are getting worse.
candidate_fi: Fyysinen terveys ja mielenterveys heikkenevät.
back_translation_en: Physical health and mental health are deteriorating.

source_text_en: People who are less well with other life shortening physical or mental illnesses or health conditions. There is no treatment available or it will not work well.
candidate_fi: Ihmiset, joiden terveydentila on heikentynyt ja joilla on muita elinikää lyhentäviä fyysisiä sairauksia, mielenterveyden sairauksia tai terveydentiloja. Hoitoa ei ole saatavilla tai se ei tehoa hyvin.
back_translation_en: People whose health has deteriorated and who have other life-shortening physical illnesses, mental illnesses, or health conditions. Treatment is not available or does not work well.

source_text_en: More problems with speaking and communicating; swallowing is getting worse.
candidate_fi: Enemmän ongelmia puhumisessa ja viestimisessä; nieleminen vaikeutuu.
back_translation_en: More problems with speaking and communicating; swallowing becomes more difficult.

source_text_en: What we can do to help this person and their family.
candidate_fi: Mitä voimme tehdä tämän henkilön ja hänen perheensä auttamiseksi.
back_translation_en: What can we do to help this person and their family.

source_text_en: Chest infections or pneumonia; breathing problems.
candidate_fi: Rintakehän infektioita tai keuhkokuume; hengitysongelmia.
back_translation_en: Chest infections or pneumonia; breathing problems.

source_text_en: Start talking with the person and their family or carer about help needed now and why making plans is important in case things change.
candidate_fi: Aloita keskustelu henkilön ja hänen perheensä tai hänestä huolehtivan ihmisen kanssa siitä, mitä apua tarvitaan nyt ja miksi suunnitelmien tekeminen on tärkeää siltä varalta, että asiat muuttuvat.
back_translation_en: Start a discussion with the person and their family or the person who cares for them about what help is needed now and why making plans is important in case things change.

source_text_en: Ongoing disability with increasing physical and/or mental health problems after one or more strokes.
candidate_fi: Jatkuva toimintarajoite, johon liittyy lisääntyviä fyysisen terveyden ja/tai mielenterveyden ongelmia yhden tai useamman aivohalvauksen jälkeen.
back_translation_en: Ongoing functional limitation with increasing physical health and/or mental health problems after one or more strokes.

source_text_en: Ask for help and advice from a nurse, doctor, social worker or other staff if the person or family needs a review of their care and support.
candidate_fi: Pyydä apua ja neuvoa sairaanhoitajalta, lääkäriltä, sosiaalityöntekijältä tai muulta henkilökunnalta, jos henkilö tai perhe tarvitsee hoitonsa ja tukensa tarkastelua.
back_translation_en: Ask for help and advice from a nurse, doctor, social worker, or other staff if the person or family needs their care and support to be reviewed.

source_text_en: We look at the person’s medicines and other treatments to give the best care. Holistic care includes symptoms, emotional, social, functional, financial, spiritual, cultural problems.
candidate_fi: Tarkastelemme henkilön lääkkeitä ja muita hoitoja, jotta voimme antaa parasta hoitoa. Kokonaisvaltainen hoito kattaa oireet sekä tunne-elämään, sosiaaliseen elämään, toimintakykyyn, talouteen, henkisiin ja hengellisiin kysymyksiin sekä kulttuuriin liittyvät ongelmat.
back_translation_en: We review the person's medicines and other treatments so that we can provide the best care. Holistic care covers symptoms as well as problems related to emotional life, social life, functioning, finances, mental and spiritual issues, and culture.

source_text_en: Ask for specialist help if symptoms or problems are difficult to manage.
candidate_fi: Pyydä asiantuntija-apua, jos oireita tai ongelmia on vaikea hallita.
back_translation_en: Ask for specialist help if symptoms or problems are difficult to manage.

source_text_en: Care plans are shared with staff who need to see them and kept up to date.
candidate_fi: Hoitosuunnitelmat jaetaan henkilökunnalle, jonka tarvitsee nähdä ne, ja ne pidetään ajan tasalla.
back_translation_en: Care plans are shared with staff who need to see them, and they are kept up to date.

source_text_en: SPICT – 4ALL 2026
candidate_fi: SPICT – 4ALL 2026
back_translation_en: SPICT – 4ALL 2026

source_text_en: A liver transplant is not possible.
candidate_fi: Maksansiirto ei ole mahdollinen.
back_translation_en: Liver transplantation is not possible.
